PFPI

FERRARIS SPEED TO PFPI WEEK 10 CROWN, WHILE LLAMAS VAULT INTO FIRST PLACE OVERALL BY 1 GAME

Christie’s Ferraris win PFPI Week 10 honors with an 11-3 mark, while Tati’s Llamas are alone in first place overall for the first time all season – by 1 game over Dick’s Roughriders and Mom’s Maniacs.

Gracelin’s Giraffes bagged the week’s lone Unique Hit, scoring a Coonskin pelt for the  Browns’ win.

PFPI’s 23rd season of the modern era is now into its second half – 10 weeks in and eight still to go – in the long climb to the Dad’s Dynamics Cup championship trophy.
